Definition: just so, referring to the previous or following context
BiblicalUsage: Kakah means 'just so' — in this manner, after this fashion. Thus shall ye eat the Passover, with loins girded and staff in hand; thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies; thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that 'thus' is a word of pattern: God gives the manner as well as the matter, and doing it His way is part of doing it at all.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
